fact_text: Reports said a term sheet with banks would settle about PKR 1.2 trillion of power-sector circular debt, with roughly half funded as bank capital injection paid to the CPPA.

fact_text: The analyst thinks banks can absorb the circular debt settlement, while other market participants doubt banks can fund such a sum without adding non-performing loans.

fact_text: Figures between about PKR 50 billion and PKR 80 billion were reported for five or six large banks in the circular debt term-sheet discussion.
